title: 'Blade Runner 2099' & 'Rivals': The big TV shows to watch this month
summary: "Blade Runner" returns with a futuristic twist, while British bonkbuster "Rivals" is back with part two of season two. TV critic Dheepthika Laurent joins Eve Jackson to review the month’s big releases, including Netflix’s acclaimed Arctic comedy "North of North" and the lavish K-drama "Remarried Empress".
